sloka: परिद्यूनं विषण्णं च स तमायान्तमब्रवीत् ।मोघं कर्तुं न शक्यं तु ब्राह्ममस्त्रं तदुच्यताम् ।। ५.३८.३६।।।।
transliteration: paridyūnaṁ viṣaṇṇaṁ ca sa tamāyāntamabravīt ।moghaṁ kartuṁ na śakyaṁ tu brāhmamastraṁ taducyatām ।। 5.38.36।।।।

translations.english: 'Then that crow said, 'let my right eye be blinded'. you then hit the right eye of the crow'. Thus the crow offered his right eye and saved himself.
